headline: Nike (NKE) Is Betting Big on Basketball’s Next Generation. Will It Pay Off?
summary: Nike Inc.’s (NYSE:NKE) latest move comes as the company continues to work toward restoring investor confidence in its turnaround story. It has made a major investment in Victor Wembanyama, a generational talent representing the NBA’s San Antonio Spurs, through a signature shoe line.
